leach.definition:
n. the process of leaching
v. cause (a liquid) to leach or percolate
v. permeate or penetrate gradually
leach.translation:
vt. 过滤, 萃取
vi. 滤掉
n. 过滤, 过滤器, 沥出物

leachability.translation: n. 可滤取, 可滤去

leachable.translation: a. 可滤取的, 可滤去的

leached.translation: v. <术>（将化学品、矿物质等）过滤( leach的过去式和过去分词 ); （液体）过滤, 滤去

leached cossettes.translation: [机] 沥滤甜菜丝; 沥滤过的甜菜切片

leaches.definition:
n the process of leaching
v cause (a liquid) to leach or percolate
v permeate or penetrate gradually
v remove substances from by a percolating liquid
leaches.translation: n. <术>（将化学品、矿物质等）过滤( leach的名词复数 ); （液体）过滤, 滤去

leaching.definition:
n the process of leaching
v cause (a liquid) to leach or percolate
v permeate or penetrate gradually
v remove substances from by a percolating liquid
leaching.translation:
[计] 浸提, 浸析
[化] 浸取; 浸提; 沥滤; 沥取; 液固萃取

leaching chromate.translation: [医] 铬酸铅, 铬黄, 汞黄

leaching iv.translation: [医] 第四导程(右手,左手,左腿)

leaching monoxide.translation: [医] 一氧化铅, 蜜陀僧

leaching tetroxide.translation: [医] 四氧化铅, 红铅, 铅丹

leaching white.translation: [医] 铅白, 碳酸铅白, 硷式碳酸铅

leaching-out.translation: [化] 沥滤出; 洗出; 浸出

leachy.definition:
a. Permitting liquids to pass by percolation; not capable of
   retaining water; porous; pervious; -- said of gravelly or sandy soils,
   and the like.
leachy.translation: a. 有气孔的, 能渗透的

leacock.definition: n Canadian economist best remembered for his humorous writings (1869-1944)
leacock.translation: n. [姓氏] 里柯克(加拿大作家,作品以幽默著称,1869-1944)
